column1: # source: Elexon Insights API (data.elexon.co.uk/bmrs/api/v1), pulled 2026-11-21. Outturn: /demand/outturn (INDO, initialDemandOutturn). 2-14 day: /datasets/NDFD (one publish/day ~14:45 UK; demand = forecast daily peak national demand), lead_days = forecastDate - publish date (UK). Day-ahead: /datasets/NDF, for each half-hour of day D the latest publish at or before 10:00 UK on D-1 (publishes arrive in fragments, so the window starts 22:00Z on D-2). NDF_dailypeak_DA = max of that half-hourly forecast vs max INDO. Target days 2021-04-01..2026-03-31; days with <46 INDO periods dropped; May 2021 absent from the NDF pull.
